description: Records the user's interest in a feature that Overfit has planned but not built yet; the planned features are listed by get_overfit_catalog under `planned`. Intended only for requests where the user says they want one of these features. Each request is stored and counted. Optional notiz: the intended use (max 280 characters, no personal data).

feature.description: Id of the planned feature from get_overfit_catalog `planned`, e.g. 'konto_im_chat'.

name.description: Optional: your agent or project name (max 60 characters).

notiz.description: Optional: what the user wants to do with it (max 280 characters).

name: register_feature_interest
title: Interesse an geplanter Funktion vormerken
